AKTIVISDA.FIRST_PARAGRAPH: Aktivisda is a website that allows committed movements all around the world to create communication materials (social networks, posters, stickers, etc.) from a graphic charter (colors, fonts, symbols, backgrounds, etc.) created by graphic designers. Aktivisda is the continuation and opening to other committed movements of XR Viz Generator, which had been used extensively by local XR branches all around the world.
AKTIVISDA.HEADER: Aktivisda, a software to create and spread your committed artworks around the world.
AKTIVISDA.SECOND_PARAGRAPH:
Aktivisda is an open source project under LGPL-3.0 license, and is open to contributions.
Source code available on Framagit.
. Please contact the team at contact@aktivisda.earth if you want to use Aktivisda for your own organisation, or if you're willing to contribute to the project.

BACKGROUND_ZONES.BACKGROUND_EXPLANATIONS: The blue area is the one behind the symbol when the latter is used on a QR code. There must be no holes in it. The blue and yellow areas are quite similar.
BACKGROUND_ZONES.CLICKABLE_ZONE_EXPLANATIONS: The yellow area corresponds to where the image can be selected by clicking on it. This area must follow the outlines of the symbol. There may be gaps if the symbol is ‘hollow’.
